input.question: Can I email a customer's SSN to myself for safekeeping?

expected.answer: Summary: No — customer PII may not leave the canonical CRM. Policy: InfoSec-DataHandling §4 — emailing or screenshotting PII is treated as a data-leak event. Escalate to: security@example.com immediately if you have already done so.

rationale: Tests three-part style on a clear-no answer.

input.question: How many vacation days can I roll over to next year?

expected.answer: Summary: Up to five (5) days of unused PTO may carry over; remainder is forfeited. Policy: HR-PTO §4.1 — rollover cap is enforced on January 1. Escalate to: People Ops if you have a documented reason for unused PTO (medical leave overlap, etc.).

input.question: Is it ok to fork a paid SaaS tool's open-source SDK and patch it for our use?

expected.answer: Summary: Permitted only if the SDK's license allows redistribution of modifications and the fork stays internal. Policy: Legal-OSS §3 — review the upstream license + the SaaS provider's terms of service before patching. Escalate to: oss-review@example.com with the license file + intended use case.

rationale: Tests nuanced 'depends' answer in the same three-part shape.

input.question: Where do I report retaliation after filing a complaint?

expected.answer: Summary: Report directly to the third-party Ethics Hotline; retaliation is explicitly prohibited. Policy: HR-Conduct §1.3 — every complaint and report is protected; retaliation triggers a separate disciplinary track. Escalate to: ethics-hotline@example.com (external administrator) for confidential reporting.

rationale: Cites both the protection clause and the right channel.

input.question: Can I run a side consulting gig on weekends?

expected.answer: Summary: Yes for non-competing engagements after manager + HR approval. Policy: HR-OutsideEmployment §2 — disclose every outside engagement via the outside-employment form; competing work is prohibited. Escalate to: People Ops with the form and a description of the engagement.

rationale: Mirrors training-set pattern; tests style transfer not just content.

input.question: How do I report a phishing email targeting our finance team?

expected.answer: Summary: Forward to phish@example.com with full headers, then alert security on-call. Policy: InfoSec-Phishing §2 — every reported phish triggers a same-day takedown attempt and a check for additional victims. Escalate to: security-oncall@example.com (paged via PagerDuty) if any recipient interacted with the email.

rationale: Two-step escalation path matches the style guide.

input.question: What's the policy on using personal Gmail for work?

expected.answer: Summary: Prohibited — work correspondence must stay in the corporate email tenant. Policy: InfoSec-Email §1.2 — personal email accounts are not under the company's retention, audit, or DLP controls. Escalate to: it-help@example.com for legitimate-need exceptions (which are rare).

rationale: Concise, no hedging, names the exception path.

input.question: Can I keep my company laptop after I leave the company?

expected.answer: Summary: No — all company hardware must be returned within five (5) business days of your final day. Policy: HR-Offboarding §3.2 — IT provides a return-shipping label; cost is borne by the company. Escalate to: it-offboarding@example.com if you need a return-label expedited or extended.

rationale: Standard offboarding question with specific window.
